artworks.title: Amphiaraus departing for Thebes (Attic red-figure kylix, detail)
artworks.description: The seer Amphiaraus mounts his chariot while Eriphyle holds the golden necklace — the bribe that would send him underground at Thebes and, a generation later, send her son Alcmaeon to kill her for the same cursed gift.

artworks.title: Heracles and Achelous
artworks.description: The great Achelous in bull form — the river god who in Apollodorus' tale purified Alcmaeon at his springs, gave him the silt-formed islands, and wed him to Callirrhoe before the necklace dragged the wanderer back to death at Psophis.
